description:
Cast Whirlwind Technique by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target(s).
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha either from your hand or command zone by paying its mana cost plus commander tax if applicable, reduced by Planar Gate.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Whirlwind Technique targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve Whirlwind Technique, airbending Naru Meha.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha from exile by paying {0} due to Planar Gate.
Repeat from step 3.
